records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 把 Copilot 直接嵌入 Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品組合，作為 AI‑驅動的核心功能，並以此推動雲端收入成長與使用者數量擴張【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  

- 在 Microsoft 365 Commercial 中，Copilot 與 Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security、Power BI、Exchange、SharePoint、Teams、Security & Compliance 等服務一起計入「Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue」指標，成為衡量雲端營收成長的關鍵項目【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142】。  
- 微軟將 Copilot 視為 AI‑enabled 工具與功能，透過在溝通、協作、分析、安全、合規等多個業務生產力領域加入 AI 功能與代理情境，來提升每位使用者的平均收入（ARPU）與整體安裝基礎的成長【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- 這些 AI 功能的加入被納入 Microsoft 365 Commercial 座位（seat）成長與雲端收入成長的度量，協助管理層與投資人評估商業健康度與未來表現【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142】。  

因此，Copilot 的整合策略是把它作為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 套件的一部份，與其他核心服務共同計入雲端收入與座位成長指標，並以 AI 功能提升產品價值與市場擴張。

Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. He said Control represents about 40% of the company’s pipeline, compared with 26% of blended revenue contribution last year, while resiliency remains close to 60%. records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過 Windows 作為平台，直接提升雲端服務與 Copilot 的使用參與度，因為 Windows 被用來推動雲端業務、擴大 PC 市佔，並促進使用者對包括 Copilot 在內的各項服務的互動【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  

- 微軟明確指出「Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services like … Copilot」——也就是說，Windows 的普及讓更多使用者接觸到 Microsoft Cloud，進而提升對 Copilot 等 AI 服務的使用率【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  
- 同時，微軟在 10‑K 中強調其安全與 AI 產品是「integrated AI‑driven products addressing security, compliance, identity, management, and privacy across customers’ multi‑cloud」的整體解決方案，這些跨雲與多平台的安全與 AI 能力在 Windows 環境中得到延伸，進一步鼓勵企業客戶在 Windows 上採用雲端與 Copilot 相關的 AI 工作流程【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  
- 微軟的長期策略聚焦於「Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform」以及「Apply AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work and business processes, and provide substantive productivity gains using Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents」；而 Windows 作為核心作業系統，成為連結這些雲端與 AI 服務的入口，使使用者在熟悉的桌面環境中更容易接觸並使用 Copilot 等服務【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  

綜合上述，Windows 不僅提升 PC 市佔，還透過與雲端安全、AI 產品的整合，成為推動 Microsoft Cloud 與 Copilot 參與度的關鍵渠道【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟透過在 **Microsoft 365 Commercial** 產品組合中加入 **Microsoft 365 Copilot**，把 AI 功能直接嵌入 Office 各套件（如 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 等），提供 AI 驅動的寫作、分析與創作工具【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。

- **Microsoft 365 Commercial** 被定位為「AI‑powered」的商務與生產力平台，將 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 以及 Enterprise Mobility + Security 整合在一起，讓使用者在日常工作中即能使用 AI 產生的建議與自動化功能【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- AI 功能主要透過 **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 以及其他 AI‑enabled 工具與功能實現，這些工具被加入到核心產品與服務中，涵蓋 **communication、collaboration、analytics、security、compliance** 等多個商務生產力領域【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- 在 **Microsoft 365 Consumer** 部分，AI 工具與新功能也被加入，以提升個人使用者的創意與生產力，並透過 Outlook.com、OneDrive 等服務提供 AI 驅動的通訊與儲存功能【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  

因此，微軟的做法是把 AI 以 **Copilot** 為核心，作為 Microsoft 365（包括 Office）的一部分，讓 AI 功能成為產品功能套件的一環，直接在 Office 應用程式內提供即時的智能協助。

records.answer:
微軟的雲端服務在最近的九個月（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日）成長非常快，商務雲端收入年增率約在 18%‑19% 之間，消費者雲端收入年增率則在 29%‑33% 之間【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105】。

- **Microsoft 365 商務雲端收入**  
  - 依 10‑Q 中「九個月結束於 2026/03/31」的綜合敘述，商務雲端收入成長 **18%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】。  
  - 同一份 10‑Q 另一段落則指出商務雲端收入成長 **19%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105】。兩者皆屬於同一九個月期間，只是分別在不同的說明段落中給予略有差異的增長率。

- **Microsoft 365 消費者雲端收入**  
  - 在同樣的九個月期間，消費者雲端收入成長 **29%**（來源於「Microsoft 365 Consumer products and cloud services revenue increased 14 億美元（$1.4 billion） or 27%」的說明）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】。  
  - 另一段落則報導消費者雲端收入成長 **33%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105】。同樣屬於九個月結束於 2026/03/31 的資料，只是不同段落的表述略有差異。

- **其他相關雲端指標**  
  - Microsoft 365 商務雲端的使用者每位收入（revenue per user）提升，主要受 Microsoft 365 E5 與 Copilot 推動【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】。  
  - Microsoft 365 消費者雲端的使用者每位收入亦提升，且消費者訂閱者增長 7%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105】。  

綜合上述，無論是商務還是消費者部門，微軟的雲端服務在最近的九個月內均呈現兩位數的高速成長，顯示出強勁的需求與持續的使用者付費提升。
